bayts.text: I walk with the pious when I walk, while the enemies thought that I was a captive there.
My journey, with the elect, is toward Allah through the Prophet, and I never have a journey toward any but Allah.
The (divine) attraction makes me journey, which has led me to a Generous One for Whom what I desire is easy.
My gratitude, with my pens, my heart and my body, (goes) to Him Who has been for me with generosity, and He is the Appreciative (Ash-Shakūr).
My victories, my support and my protection among the enemies (come) from the All-Embracing, the Bestower (Al-Wahhāb): He is the Helper (An-Naṣīr).
My commander, in my journey and in my staying, is my means (of access, the Prophet), (I being) a servant to him; and he provides for the Khadīm (the Servant).
My rewards rest with the Bestower — sublime is His munificence — for the service of the Chosen One (Muḥammad), and He is the One Who recompenses.
My vow is my being a servant of the Lord of the Throne, He alone, (and) an attendant of the Best of creation, and he is the Warner (Muḥammad).
The All-Sufficient (Al-Kāfī) protects me, through him (the Prophet), from the harm of the enemies and from every evil, and He — exalted be He — is the Protector (Al-Mujīr).
My destiny is my being His servant, attendant of the Prophet; and the affair of creatures comes to God.
My months and my days, tomorrow, will be witnesses for me of my being a servant of Allah, and that is renowned.
My (protecting) veils in the two Abodes are my praise of Muḥammad, in verse and in prose: and he is an excellent concealer (of faults).
My seeds are the Book of Allah and the Sunna, by which I shelter from that toward which the slanderer has turned.
My palaces have emptied and my family has been parted from me, for my praise of him for whom all eulogy falls short.
The Deceiver of creatures (Satan) has deceived the Nazarenes with his cunning, and they made suppositions, and suppositions are deception.
Toward my Lord (goes) my turning, not toward them, repenting to Him of sin and of faults: He is the All-Forgiving (Al-Ghafūr).
To Him I have repented of the fault of my turning toward other than Him, and from me to Him (there is) a covenant, binding upon me, kept in my innermost.
To Him I have repented, (I) a party to a pact of sale (Qurʾān 9:111), and I hope for His good pleasure; and from me to Him (goes) a gratitude that endures, abundant.
I have been surprised by a gladness from Him, (so that) I seek to thank Him for it with purity; and the sojourn (here) is joy.
And in the heart (there is), of His good pleasure, what I conceal, jealously guarding it: truly breasts are tombs (of secrets).
To my Lord (goes) my praise, (I) well pleased with Him and thankful, for the secret of my secret; and the All-Aware (Al-Khabīr) is truly aware.
I am well pleased with Him as Lord, Who subjects what He wills to whom He wills, with ease, and He is the All-Powerful (Al-Qadīr).
How generous He is as Lord, Who has kept the enemies from me and driven aspirations to me, though (my) person is lowly!
I have been enriched by Him as Lord and Protector, Who leads my aspiration to me; and I am thankful and poor (before Him).
My affairs I have entrusted to Him, with a serene heart, (I) a stranger among the enemies, and He is the All-Seeing (Al-Baṣīr).
My companions are the Book of Allah, the Chosen One, the Prophet, and his Companions, on the sea, when I wander.
I address him with praise while he is in Ṭayba (Medina), and I am for him a neighbour who visits (him) there.
I address him, and he is the means (of access) forever; and in my heart there is, from his good pleasure, joy.
And I addressed him on the sea, when my journey reached its end in Allah and the Chosen One, and he is the Illuminator.
O Prophet of right guidance, here my soul has found peace; and you are worthy of my praise as of the prayer (of blessing).
So ask my Creator to tame the enemies for me, all together, along with that with which I return to dry land: you are the Warner.
So ask my Creator to hasten my return with my wish (fulfilled): that is, for the Generous Lord, easy.
Upon you a blessing from Him — exalted be He — greeting (you) with peace, together with the Family and the Companions: what excellent full moons!
And from Him a blessing with peace to you, O hope of my breast, O you whose bounty is (like) oceans.
Succour me, succour me, O my Intercessor, my means (of access), here and tomorrow, on the Day when the heaven will heave (Qurʾān 52:9).
And lead me, laden with spoils, away from the wicked and the sea, to the dry land and the pious: you are the Bringer of glad tidings.
So give the people of Islam glad tidings of me soon, and be the one who illumines Islam through me: you are the Illuminator.
Blessing and peace from Allah forever upon the best of those to whom troubles are laid bare.
upon the Best of all Allah's creation, Muḥammad, my Intercessor, who guards and illumines my whole being,
together with the Family and the Companions, lions against the enemies, all together, who drive away from me whoever would do wrong.
Upon his intimate friend, the Truthful (Abū Bakr), the good pleasure of his Lord, just as he was his companion in the cave when (the Prophet) journeyed (in the Hijra).
Upon his sword, the Discerner (ʿUmar al-Fārūq), from his Lord a great good pleasure, just as (he) defended, and he was (his) minister.
And from Him, for the Possessor of the two Lights (ʿUthmān), I seek His good pleasure, just as he attained the two Lights, and he was patient.
Upon the father of the two grandsons (ʿAlī), the most sublime good pleasure, just as he destroyed the enemies with the sword, and he was renowned.
Upon all the Companions the good pleasure of their Lord, just as they fought whoever did wrong: how evil is the disbeliever!
Through them I hope from my King for His help against the associators of the Trinity, when they do wrong.
They think me, in the time of my exile among them, their captive, but all of them there go astray.
(They are) bewildered, captives of the devils and of passion; and I am the captive of the Lord of the Throne — exalted be He —.
I walk toward the Lord of land and sea, worshipping, and I never walk toward the wicked.
My journey is toward the Bestower — sublime is His majesty — and I have no journey toward any but the Generous.
I have held fast to the firm Rope (the Qurʾān), chanting (it), and to the most trustworthy Handhold (Qurʾān 2:256), which is light.
Through it I journeyed from my Lord to my Lord, professing Oneness, while around me (were) the Nazarenes and the seas heaved.
It is the treasure, the alchemical sulphur (the spiritual elixir) and the provision for me here; through it, tomorrow, the Fire and ruin vanish.
A noble Book, from a Generous One (Al-Karīm) Who honours, for a noble servant (Muḥammad), who provides for the Khadīm (the Servant).
A glorious Book, from a Glorious One (Al-Majīd) Who glorifies, for a glorious servant (Muḥammad), who harms the disbeliever.
Upon him through whom (the Book) came to us from Him, as a warner, a blessing that guards me from evil wherever I walk.
